summary: Clearwater NF lookout tower with an L-4 cab, near Pierce, Idaho: built 1934, abandoned 1964, now gone. Warren Yahr is listed as its keeper in 1945-1948.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1964 and gone; no source describes what remains.

staffing.status: staffed by Warren Yahr (Idaho Fire Lookouts)

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags it as a hike-in site. No source describes the site today.

corrections.why: 6.1 m is 20 feet, which the sources give for a separate 20-foot platform tower about half a mile northeast of the lookout. No source gives a height for the L-4 lookout itself.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts gives only Removed, with no date. firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the June 2016 Clearwater NF list give abandonment in 1964 and treat the site as gone. The story uses 1964.

notes_for_editor: Staffing rests on one Idaho Fire Lookouts staff record citing Yahr's book Smokechaser; the book was not read. The brief's height_m of 6.1 matches the 20-foot platform, so a removal is proposed rather than a replacement figure. The June 2016 Clearwater NF list is a compilation from Kresek's book and Forest Service records. No remains described; no photos captured.
